decisions.scenario: Finding a Monday train from Ely to Cambridge and checking its fare, arrival time, and train ID

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'd like to find a train departing from Ely on Monday, please.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Okay. What is your destination, and what time would you like to leave?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'm going to Cambridge and need to leave after 13:15.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are six trains leaving after 13:15 on Monday. Do you have a preferred arrival time?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Any of them will do. Can you give me the price, arrival time, and train ID for one option?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Train TR4849 leaves at 13:35 and arrives at 13:52. The fare is £4.40. Is there anything else I can help with?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I think that's all I need. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You're welcome. Have a great day!
